出生地: 意大利,托斯卡纳,阿雷佐
简介: Cole Mitchell Sprouse (born August 4, 1992)[2] is an American actor, and twin brother of Dylan Sprouse. He is known for his role as Cody Martin on the Disney Channel series The Suite Life of Zack & Cody and its spinoff The Suite Life on Deck. As of 2017, Sprouse stars as Jughead Jones on The CW television series Riverdale.
